title: End a run whose runtime is gone input
description: At start the daemon asks the runtime about each run the record holds as Running or WaitingOnDecision; for a run the runtime no longer holds it issues this command. The run is Ended with the outcome `orphaned`, the cause. In the same step every Open decision request of the run moves to Withdrawn, as in CancelRun (the outcome's `affects` entry): no WithdrawDecision follows. The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.run-orphaned` (record: run_id, the state the run held, the reason) just before the run is Ended; the language cannot write a RunEvent from this command (see CancelRun), so the event is stated here. Issued by the daemon itself (actor DaemonProcess): it has no route in the HTTP contract.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
